author: @toucanodd2889
text:
I went and counted madness clears:

Vortice 74
Lotan 67
Tawil 60
24 59
Salvador 54
GMurphy 48
Mouchette 45
Glotan 34
Caraboo 22
Aigis 16
Gogier 15
Pontos 13
Ghellot 11
Castor 7
Pollux 6
Kath 6
Doresain 6

Mouchette was picked 95% of the time (43 times) for Wave 1, and I find it extremely amusing that Flares happened to completely avoid filtering the waves that actually had Mouchette clears. He accidentally did show one when filtering for Gogier, which is what got me to look for myself.

While the fact that she sits on Wave 1 shows she can't keep up with the big boys, she is the SECOND best choice. For all Flares shits on her, she is one of the most played Madness Awakeners, and when you need 5–10 teams, she is more than good enough to fall into those ranks (until more power creep happens).

Any team can apparently clear Wave 1, pure coincidence that Mouchette is picked so often compared to the majority of other units.
